**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant. Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", and "personnel" returned nothing on point:

- **§ 5.4** (the planner's likely location) only requires each Party to appoint a General Manager as liaison — no restriction on hiring the other side's people.
- **§ 10.2** confirms an independent-contractor relationship and expressly disclaims any employment relationship, but imposes no hiring restraint.
- **§ 6 (Exclusivity)** is the only restrictive covenant set, and it is directed at competing web projects, not employees. The two-year restraint in § 6.3 binds **HDI**, not us, so it is not flagged (it benefits our party); § 6.1's restraint on the Company is a competition/exclusivity term outside this rule's scope.

This satisfies the **preferred position** — no non-solicit on Customer — so nothing is redlined here.
